instructions: Start with a blank pdf project for edit-new?pdfjs=1
Subtask 30 needs a text-bearing document instead of the blank page

tests.title: Setup: blank PDF project loads in /edit-new?pdfjs=1 with the Add Text tool available
tests.summary: Precondition for the whole story: the page rasterises, both add-text controls are present and enabled, no text box exists, the Text Options panel is closed, and the console is clean. Also confirms this is the pdf.js editor rather than the legacy one.

tests.title: Add Text toggles from both toolbars and is exclusive with the other tools
tests.summary: The top-bar and floating buttons drive one shared mode, toggling off places nothing, another tool cancels add-text mode, and placing a box leaves the mode so a second click cannot place another.
tests.automation_note: Exclusivity is asserted against the Shapes tool. Draw, Highlight, Sign and the edit-mode toggle still need a manual pass.

tests.title: Click-to-place creates a text box with the documented defaults
tests.summary: A single click yields a 36 x 15 pt box whose top-left is the click point, in Helvetica 12pt black on a transparent background at full opacity, left/top aligned, unlocked, selected, and not flagged as user-sized.

tests.title: Drag-to-size honours the dragged rectangle, with a click fallback below the threshold
tests.summary: A drag over 20 x 10 px takes the dragged geometry and is flagged user-sized; an up-and-left drag is normalised rather than inverted; a sub-threshold drag falls back to click-to-place defaults. No preview element is left behind in either case.
tests.automation_note: Drag cancellation by Escape or lost pointer capture is not automated yet.

tests.title: New boxes are clamped inside the page, on any page of the document
tests.summary: Clicks at the page corners and an oversized drag are all pulled back inside the page: no negative coordinates, no overhang past the right or bottom edge, and the box keeps a usable size.
tests.automation_note: Multi-page placement (page 2 and the last page) is not automated yet.

tests.title: Placement stays accurate across zoom levels
tests.summary: Click and drag placement at fit-width, 50%, 100%, 200% and an odd zoom must land under the pointer and produce identical PDF coordinates; an existing box must stay anchored when zoom changes.
tests.automation_note: Zoom is driven through the +/- controls, so the levels are whatever the viewer steps to rather than named percentages.

tests.title: Rotated pages are not editable, and rotating back restores the tool
tests.summary: This build renders a rotated page as one flattened image so saved masks stay aligned, marks editing unavailable, and explains why in a dialog. The Add Text tool places nothing while the page is rotated. Rotating back to 0 degrees restores placement, and an existing box survives the round trip with its top-left corner intact.
tests.automation_note: The original QA wording assumed text could be placed on a rotated page. Automation showed it cannot, so the case now covers the real contract. Placement accuracy at 90/180/270 cannot be tested until rotated pages become editable.

tests.title: A newly placed box opens in edit mode with the caret ready
tests.summary: The new box is selected and editing with the caret inside its editable element, so typing lands without another click; the hover menu is anchored over it; and placing a second box commits the first rather than leaving two editors open.

tests.title: Typing, multi-line entry, word wrap and box reflow
tests.summary: Long paragraphs wrap inside the box width, an over-long word splits mid-word, hard line breaks survive a commit and reload, and reflow keeps text inside the box border at large font sizes.
tests.automation_note: Wrapping, mid-word breaks and hard line breaks are automated through a save and reload. Behaviour at very large font sizes still needs a manual pass. Runs with the editor rendered as signed in: edit mode is premium-gated, and a committed text box cannot be re-selected without it.

tests.title: Commit and cancel paths, and what happens to an empty box
tests.summary: Committing by click-away, Escape, selecting another annotation and switching tools all keep the text and leave edit mode cleanly. Also records what the editor does with an empty or whitespace-only box.
tests.automation_note: Confirms that a box committed empty, or containing only whitespace, is discarded rather than persisted as an invisible annotation. Runs with the editor rendered as signed in: edit mode is premium-gated, and a committed text box cannot be re-selected without it.

tests.title: Text Options panel opens for the selection and mirrors its state
tests.summary: Every control is read from the selected box, re-reads fully when a differently styled box is selected, hides on close and deselect, and is disabled on a locked annotation.
tests.automation_note: FAILING: box-level bold does not survive a re-render of the annotation layer — placing a second text box reverts it, on the page as well as in the panel. The annotation is saved with fontWeight 700, so the loss is in the re-render replaying stored rich-text runs that still carry the pre-bold weight. Every other control in this case passes. Runs with the editor rendered as signed in: edit mode is premium-gated, and a committed text box cannot be re-selected without it.

tests.title: Font family: standard, Google and document-embedded fonts
tests.summary: Each font group re-renders the page text immediately and survives reload and download without falling back to Helvetica. The Google Fonts separator must not be selectable.
tests.automation_note: The standard PDF faces are asserted end to end. Google faces are asserted as far as the stored value only: the test container has no outbound route, so whether the webfont actually renders still needs a manual pass, as do document-embedded fonts. Runs with the editor rendered as signed in: edit mode is premium-gated, and a committed text box cannot be re-selected without it.

tests.title: Font size slider: 2-72pt curve with 12pt at the midpoint
tests.summary: The pt label tracks the slider live, the mapping is exponential with slider 50 = 12pt, and the value round-trips through save and reload without drifting.

tests.title: Text colour and background colour, including live preview
tests.summary: Both colours preview live and commit on close, the background stays transparent until chosen, and both survive save, reload and download.

tests.title: Opacity
tests.summary: Each opacity step fades text and background together, is reflected on reselect, is preserved in the download, and an off-step saved value snaps to the nearest option.

tests.title: Bold, italic and underline
tests.summary: Each toggle updates the page text and its own pressed state, combinations work together, and all survive save, reload and download — including fonts with no real bold or italic cut.

tests.title: Horizontal and vertical alignment
tests.summary: Left/centre/right and top/middle/bottom are visible on the page, persist through save and reload, match in the downloaded PDF, and behave on a wrapped multi-line paragraph.

tests.title: Uppercase and lowercase transforms
tests.summary: The stored text really changes case rather than gaining a CSS text-transform, handles digits, punctuation and non-ASCII, and each transform is a single undo step.

tests.title: Partial-selection (inline) formatting and mixed-state reporting
tests.summary: Applying a style to part of the text changes only that run, a mixed selection reports as mixed, runs survive commit, reload and download, and Ctrl/Cmd+A selects the box text rather than the page.

tests.title: Hyperlink apply and remove
tests.summary: Apply and remove work on a selection and are disabled without one, malformed and javascript: destinations are refused, and the link is clickable in the downloaded PDF.

tests.title: Select, deselect and the hover menu
tests.summary: Selection chrome and the hover menu appear anchored over the box and stay correct through scroll and zoom; every deselect path works; Edit text enters edit mode; and the menu does not cover a box at the top of a page.

tests.title: Move and resize
tests.summary: Dragging by body and grip follows the pointer 1:1 at every zoom and survives reload; resizing reflows the text, clamps below the minimum size, and each gesture is one undo step.

tests.title: Multi-select, marquee select and group operations
tests.summary: Shift-click and marquee build a multi-selection, a group drag moves every box by the same offset, Delete removes them in one undo step, and Escape clears the selection.

tests.title: Z-order, lock, duplicate, delete and clipboard copy/paste
tests.summary: Front/back ordering persists through save, reload and download; lock disables move, resize, edit and the panel; duplicate makes an offset copy with a new id; and copy/paste works across pages without hijacking the shortcut inside an editor.

tests.title: Undo and redo across every text operation
tests.summary: Add, type, format, inline format, move, resize, z-order, lock, duplicate, delete and paste are each exactly one step, by button and by every keyboard shortcut, and the shortcuts are ignored while the caret is in a text box.

tests.title: Autosave and explicit Save
tests.summary: Every mutation marks the document dirty and schedules an autosave with the expected status transitions; no request is sent when nothing changed; and rapid edits coalesce rather than race.

tests.title: Reload fidelity
tests.summary: A document of variously styled boxes across several pages, including a rotated one, comes back after a hard reload with identical geometry, content, styling, z-order and annotation ids.

tests.title: Downloaded PDF fidelity and burn-into-PDF
tests.summary: The downloaded PDF renders every box at the right place, size and styling with selectable text, and a burned box becomes page content that still renders after reload and download.

tests.title: Layers panel, annotation ID field and debug mask
tests.summary: Boxes are listed and named from their own text with the documented truncation and fallback, reordering changes z-order, the read-only annotation ID selects on click, and the debug mask opens against the selected box.
tests.automation_note: The debug mask and annotation ID are admin-only since NK_7, so this needs an admin session.

tests.title: Editing text that is already in the PDF
tests.summary: On a text-bearing document, editing a source span writes back surgically without moving the rest of the line, preserves typography, handles longer and shorter replacements, and does not fire once the box has been moved.
tests.automation_note: Needs a text-bearing fixture rather than the blank page the rest of the suite uses.

tests.title: Content robustness: long text, unicode, markup-like input and pasted rich text
tests.summary: Emoji, combining accents, RTL text, tabs, repeated spaces and markup-like strings are stored and echoed verbatim without being interpreted, and pasted rich text lands without injecting arbitrary HTML.

tests.title: Keyboard access and ARIA on the Text Options panel
tests.summary: Every control is tabbable in a sensible order with a visible focus ring and an accessible name, the style toggles expose aria-pressed, and the panel never steals focus from the box while typing.
